claude_proposed_widenings.name: ItemDestructionPolicy.zero_hp_vessel
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Folding Boat is permanently destroyed when either vessel form is reduced to 0 Hit Points. This is a damage-triggered destruction of the item itself, not a charge-exhaustion event. The current ItemDestructionPolicy discriminants (none / last_charge_roll / permanent_on_empty) are all resource-triggered; none covers HP-triggered item destruction.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If either vessel is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the Folding Boat is destroyed.
